SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalTreatCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status != #{visitedStatus} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingAuditCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = #{visitedStatus} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedTreatCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.treat_type = #{emergency} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.treat_type = #{outpatient} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatientCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.treat_type = #{other} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS otherCount FROM treat_mgmt AS a WHERE deleted = 0
AND apply_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS applyTime, COUNT(IF(apply_time is not null, 1, NULL)) AS count FROM treat_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0 AND (apply_time between date_sub(now(), interval 7 DAY) and now()) GROUP BY applyTime
